ev_0004.summary: Circle circle_01 is centred at O (225.98,220.25) with radius 157.2 px. Points A, B, C, D, E all lie on it (distance from O within 0.3 px of radius). Chords BD and EC cross at an unlabelled interior point near (183.65,335.65), which lies on both lines (checked against both line equations). No letter is assigned to it.
